'''Eagle Squadron''', sometimes known as the '''Emperor's Eagles''', was an elite [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadron in operation around the time of [[Operation: Clean Sweep]]. During the [[Battle between the Malevolent and the Endeavor|frigate duel]] between the ''[[Malevolent]]'' and the [[Endeavor (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Endeavor'']], the Eagles may have arrived as reinforcements in either [[TIE/ad starfighter]]s or [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|''Alpha''-class Xg-1 Star Wings]]—two of the craft the group was known to operate.
